## Fundamental Theorem of Existence

**We exist as the form of human being, living under constraints shaped by uncertainty - Time, Energy, and Resource.** 

We do not know the length of our lives, yet we know time flows forever.

We do not know the strength of tomorrow’s spirit, yet we know the body seeks rhythm in rest and hunger.

We do not know the wealth that will come or go, yet we know all resources drift with chance and choice.

| **Constraint** | **Meaning** | **Uncertainty** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Time | Life span | Random deviation from dynamic expectancy |
| Energy | Personal Wellbeing | Random fluctuation over baseline physical wellness according to mental condition |
| Resource | Societal Capital | Random allocation among changing parties under changing circumstances |

$$
\text{existence of life} \space | \space (T, E, C)
$$

Given these constraints, life naturally follows a trajectory — “a touch of destiny.” Self-awareness embodies our willingness to make the journey meaningful, while free will empowers us to make decisions that may even more or less alter the constraints that impact our life.

## My Style

**I intend to live in a style of my own.**

To do this, I formed a model called **`Strat`**, which reflects on my past journey and provides guidance for future decisions in real time. 

To better organize the data processed by Strat, I created an entity named **`STRARTS`,** which responds to these constraints and echoes the fundamental dimensions of life - Lifestyle, Education, Profession, or in simple terms: **Life**, **Study**, and **Work**.

| Dimension | Goal | Business Group in STRARTS |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lifestyle | Enrich the life journey | SANT |
| Education | Learn how to accumulate and release energy properly | ECHO |
| Profession | Strive to obtain capital | MOTE |

These three dimensions are interdependent and together form a cycle of quality life.

To enrich our life journey, we need a mentally fit mind and a physically healthy body, both supported by the resources we gather. A colorful lifestyle lays the foundation for learning how to cultivate and release our energy wisely, which in turn enables us to obtain resources essential for our life to be colorful.

I hope this two-way cycle among the three dimensions form a spiral of growth, with its by-products contributing to the society as a whole and its legacy, if any, benefiting the civilization of mankind.

Following such style, I live without regret “as a life”.
